title.fr: Bande passante et fréquences de coupure d'un filtre

sketch:
Observe: Bode magnitude plot with a movable "−3 dB" horizontal
cursor; student drags cursor onto the curve, cut-off frequencies
f_1 and f_2 auto-mark on the x-axis, bandwidth Δf = f_2 − f_1
highlights. For low/high-pass only one f_c exists. Experiment:
change R (or C) and watch f_c shift; student derives the R·C ↔ f_c
relationship from three data points. Evaluate: given a target
bandwidth, pick R and C (or R, L, C for a band-pass) that produce
it. Wrinkle: Q-factor for band-pass — narrow vs. wide, teaches
selectivity.
